meta.author: coordinator
meta.description: CPS MEABF reserve split like the CTPF levy (count x share of benefit dollars)

splits.note: CPS budgets this reserve in case it must repay the City for non-teacher staff pensions. The budget book says a $175M reimbursement depends on new revenue (budget book p.15).

pieces.name: Retired workers paid by the fund (21,874 people)
pieces.unit_label: people paid by the fund (share of this reserve)
pieces.note: This reserve is not a payment to retirees. It is split by each group's share of the fund's yearly benefits (estimate). The average yearly benefit is in extra.
pieces.why: This is a set-aside, not a payment to people. Each person's share of it is far under $1 million, and the fund does not publish who each retiree is.
